# Cloudlayer

cloudlayer.io is a document and asset generation service that enables users to dynamically create PDFs and images through a REST-based API, SDKs, or no-code integrations.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cloudlayer/.

## Actions

- **Add Storage**: Add a new user storage configuration.
- **Convert HTML to PDF**: Convert html or a public url into a pdf document.
- **Convert URL to Image**: Convert a webpage url to an image.
- **Convert URL to PDF**: Convert a url to pdf with full parameter support.
- **Get API Status** (read-only): Test api reachability.
- **Get Asset** (read-only): Retrieve a specific asset by its id.
- **HTML to Image**: Convert base64-encoded html to an image.
- **List Assets** (read-only): List the ten most recent assets.
- **List Storage Configurations** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all storage configurations.
